text: when i press move layer down it duplicates it and moves one down and keeps one at the top. that or it doesnt clean up the stale placement or something
resolution: Fixed paint-layer reorder duplicating content and delete leaving paint visible. Root cause was shared: the restore-from-paintRef effect (fires on model switch, async blob arrival, or after a dev hot reload that reset the in-memory load guard) uploaded the FLATTENED composite image onto the base layer while the other layers were still alive, so base held every layer's pixels — a reorder then drew it twice and a delete left it showing. Fix: a restore now collapses the layer stack to a single base layer and loads the flattened image there (the paintRef is one flattened image; in-session the load guard holds so your layers are untouched while working — a hot reload/reopen collapses to one, painting preserved). Hardening added: recompositeDisplay composites each unique layer id once, the stack is deduped on every change, and per-layer Paintables mount in a stable id order so reorder never churns host nodes. Builds clean (rjit ship hmsc-int exit 0); self-heals an already-corrupted stack on next reload. TS-only, so rjit dev hot-reloads it.
